question: Should OpenClaw ship this fixed HealthKit summary as a first-party health or fitness capability under the proposed disclosure and dual-authorization contract?
rationale: The existing architecture supports the capability, but maintainers must own its health-purpose positioning, App Review posture, exact sensitive fields, provider disclosure, and transcript implications before code work begins.

options.title: Approve Bounded Health Feature
options.body: Define the user-facing health or fitness benefit and ship only the fixed aggregates behind system authorization, explicit AI-provider disclosure, and gateway opt-in.

options.title: Narrow The First Release
options.body: Approve fewer metrics or periods and a smaller disclosure surface before expanding HealthKit access.

options.title: Decline First-Party HealthKit
options.body: Keep HealthKit outside the first-party app if OpenClaw cannot support the required health-purpose and privacy posture.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Health Feature
recommendation.body: Define the user-facing health or fitness benefit and ship only the fixed aggregates behind system authorization, explicit AI-provider disclosure, and gateway opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns this issue, explicitly selected the proposed architecture, and has recent history across both affected boundaries.
